title_as_printed: Solubility of methane, ethane and their mixtures in pure water at 71C (160F)
pressure_note: total pressure of the equilibrium cell (block label 'Total pressure (MPa)'), held constant within +-1%; whether it includes water vapour not stated

value.what: total hydrocarbon (both gases) in the water-rich phase, mol% printed, x = printed*0.01; pure water, salt-free; gas-phase composition in first column

value2.what: methane component in the water-rich phase

value3.what: ethane component in the water-rich phase

gas_phase_composition.col: HC phase water-free methane content % mol

conversion_needs: printed values are mol% (multiply by 0.01 for mole fraction); the sign '-' means no measurement (printed dash), not a value; empty cells are cells left blank in the print; the value column header 'Solubility (% mol) of' is read as mole percent of the component in the water-rich phase (consistent with x~0.005 for methane at 100 MPa)
gas = mixture of methane with the second hydrocarbon; builder must use column 'HC phase water-free methane content' as the gas-phase composition (y_CH4 = printed/100 on water-free basis)
notes: Block label rows are the stacked side-by-side pressure blocks. Dash cells are kept as '-'. Row 100.0 at 20 MPa total cell carries a printed arrow marker before 0.2183 (C1+C2); value kept 0.2183; meaning of marker not explained. Pure-ethane row (00.0) and pure-methane row (100.0) are the binary systems. Lower-pressure rows (72.5 and 75.5 % methane) show only the total because individual compositions were not given.

gas_per_row.col: HC phase water-free methane content % mol
